source_description_html:
This is premium quality motorcycle kit of fairings. Fairings are very light & strong with a superb finish and precise fitting. We use a lot of Kevlar & carbon reinforcement in the most stressed areas.

Bodywork is made from GFK Fiberglass FLEXI in white Aral 9003. They are UV stable and they have 3 x K-K carbon kevlar reinforcement the mounting point.

The kit is coming with kit of dzus fasteners, already pre-drilled, heat resistant foil and drains rubber plug.

Kit includes: Upper fairing, L+R side fairing, lower fairing, seat unit (upper and lower part), tank cover small, AirDuct or Fairing bracket with AirDuct, 15 x dzus fastener, heat resistant foil.
Made from GFK Fiberglass Flexi with kevlar & carbon reinforcement in the stressed areas.
